newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hirabo to issue 7.12 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Hirabo to issue 7.12 mln new shares.

text.p: Fishing nets maker Hirabo Corp said on Monday it would issue 7.12 million new shares worth 2.5 billion yen to two unlisted firms belonging to the Chisan group on March 13.
Hirabo said in a statement that the move is aimed at strengthening its financial condition.
The company posted a net loss of 1.13 billion yen in the year ended in March 1996 and expects to post net profit of 121 million yen in the year ending in March 1997.
The Chisan group firms include hotel and golf-club operator Chisan K.K.
It said the money raised will be used to pay back loans and to cover operating costs.
